name: EXPLORE_REPOSITORY
definition: Survey repository structure to build a mental map before acting.
distinguish: viewing a directory (here) vs viewing a file (READ_SOURCE)

name: LOCATE_CODE
definition: Search the codebase for the file/symbol/definition relevant to the task.
distinguish: searching for something (here) vs reading a known file (READ_SOURCE)

name: READ_SOURCE
definition: Open and read a source, test, or doc file to understand its implementation/behaviour.
distinguish: reading to understand (here) vs reading a failure to find a cause (DIAGNOSE_FAILURE)

name: RUN_TEST_SUITE
definition: Execute the project's tests (suite or a test file) to observe pass/fail status.
distinguish: first/observational run (here) vs re-run after an edit to confirm (VERIFY_FIX); vs running a repro script (REPRODUCE_ISSUE)

name: REPRODUCE_ISSUE
definition: Run a command/script to trigger and observe the reported bug.
distinguish: runs a repro/program (here) vs the test suite (RUN_TEST_SUITE); pre-fix vs post-fix (VERIFY_FIX)

name: WRITE_REPRODUCTION_SCRIPT
definition: Create a script/file that reproduces the bug for repeatable checking.
distinguish: a repro/scratch script (here) vs a kept regression test (WRITE_TEST)

name: DIAGNOSE_FAILURE
definition: Inspect failing output (traceback, diff, assertion) to identify the cause; follows a failure.
distinguish: reading because something failed (here) vs ordinary READ_SOURCE

name: INSPECT_CHANGES
definition: Review the agent's own modifications so far (git diff/status/show).
distinguish: viewing your edits/diff (here) vs reading project source (READ_SOURCE)

name: EDIT_SOURCE
definition: Modify source code to change behaviour toward fixing the issue.
distinguish: a real fix (here) vs temporary prints (ADD_DEBUG_INSTRUMENTATION) vs behaviour-preserving restructuring (REFACTOR_CODE) vs editing a test (WRITE_TEST)

name: WRITE_TEST
definition: Add or modify a test that guards the intended behaviour.
distinguish: a kept regression test (here) vs a throwaway repro (WRITE_REPRODUCTION_SCRIPT)

name: ADD_DEBUG_INSTRUMENTATION
definition: Insert temporary prints/logging/asserts to investigate behaviour (not the fix itself).
distinguish: temporary diagnostic edits (here) vs the actual fix (EDIT_SOURCE)

name: REFACTOR_CODE
definition: Restructure code without changing externally observable behaviour.
distinguish: no behaviour change (here) vs a fixing change (EDIT_SOURCE)

name: REVERT_CHANGE
definition: Undo a previous edit that failed or caused a regression.
distinguish: undo/restore prior state (here) vs making a new change (EDIT_SOURCE)

name: INSTALL_DEPENDENCY
definition: Install or configure packages needed to run the code or tests.
distinguish: installing deps (here) vs building the project (BUILD_PROJECT)

name: BUILD_PROJECT
definition: Compile/build the project so it can run (make, setup.py build, cargo/go build, mvn/gradle).

name: VERIFY_FIX
definition: Re-run the reproduction or relevant tests after a change to confirm it resolves the issue.
distinguish: post-edit confirmation (here) vs an initial RUN_TEST_SUITE / REPRODUCE_ISSUE

name: CLEANUP_ARTIFACTS
definition: Remove temporary/scratch files (repro scripts, debug output) before finalizing.
distinguish: removing scratch (here) vs reverting a source edit (REVERT_CHANGE)

name: SUBMIT_SOLUTION
definition: Finalize and submit the patch as the solution.
